notes.title: Dual Eclipse OUT NOW!
notes.content: [h2][b]v1.0[/b][/h2][h1]Dual Eclipse is out! [/h1][p]Over 20 unique Celestial cards to discover![/p][p]Steam Achievements working![/p][p]Working great on the Steamdeck![/p][p][/p][h1]What's next?[/h1][p]I've got a list I'm going through for the next few patches. You can expect small updates that tweak things and bring extra polish after launch.[/p][p][/p][p]More unique cards! There were a number of ideas I had, but didn't want to get in the way of launch, so you can expect some cool new Celestial cards in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]Class balances and tweaks! Overall I'm happy with each class, so I'm really looking for something that feels like it could use a bit more spice.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Over 20 unique Celestial cards to discover!

tags.bug: Steam Achievements working!

tags.feature: Working great on the Steamdeck!
More unique cards! There were a number of ideas I had, but didn't want to get in the way of launch, so you can expect some cool new Celestial cards in the future.

tags.balance_change: Class balances and tweaks! Overall I'm happy with each class, so I'm really looking for something that feels like it could use a bit more spice.

[*] Updated settings/tutorials to reflect WASD movement and Q&E strafing. 
[*] Added tutorial that explains enemies have abilities and where to view them.
[*] Updated language of AP and Fortitude.
[*] Improved visuals and flavor text for Level 1 Crypt.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.302
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Combat Tutorial: A short and informative combat tutorial has been added at the start of new games to address feedback and improve new player onboarding. Option to skip added.
[*] Card visuals have been updated to represent their respective elements. This includes changing "Wild" cards to Astral cards. Feedback showed players were confused about when these cards were playable. The new visual style along with the tutorial are meant to cement the idea that Astral cards act as wild cards that can play into any suit.
[*] Card Effects now have VFX that trigger when activated.
[*] Looting cards now provides two options instead of one. This has opened the door for more player agency and decision making throughout the game.
[*] Level 1 has been redesigned to be more open and with a clearer end goal. This will reduce players getting lost or turning too often.
[*] Updated monster decks to improve onboarding of level 1 and differentiate enemy personalities in level 2.
[*] Added Bluesky social link.
[/list]

tags.feature: New Combat Tutorial: A short and informative combat tutorial has been added at the start of new games to address feedback and improve new player onboarding. Option to skip added.

Card visuals have been updated to represent their respective elements. This includes changing "Wild" cards to Astral cards. Feedback showed players were confused about when these cards were playable. The new visual style along with the tutorial are meant to cement the idea that Astral cards act as wild cards that can play into any suit.
Card Effects now have VFX that trigger when activated.
Looting cards now provides two options instead of one. This has opened the door for more player agency and decision making throughout the game.
Level 1 has been redesigned to be more open and with a clearer end goal. This will reduce players getting lost or turning too often.
Updated monster decks to improve onboarding of level 1 and differentiate enemy personalities in level 2.
Added Bluesky social link.

notes.title: v0.206
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Tooltips have been added to cards! After playtesting it became really clear people wanted this feature. It also opens up possibilities for more nuanced cards to be added that would have been awkward inclusions without the additional info.
[*] Esc input now works in the main menu when viewing the Settings UI.
[*] Drag/drop clarification added to the card reward screen.
[*] Saving message added to the first load of each level. The game always saved at the start of a new level, but this wasn't obvious without the message.
[*] Added a weapon card to the Paladin starting deck.
[*] Improved tooltips for some effects and outstanding typos addressed.
[/list]
